description: The Learning Support Educator provides learning support to children in helping them develop academic, behavioural social and communication skills. He/She assesses the children's learning, develops plans and progress reports, and supports the management of children in a classroom setting. He works to identify children who require low levels of support through the use of standardised assessments and other relevant information. He also works closely with the Early Childhood educators and families of the children to further guide them in developing the children's learning needs.
